_comment: Survey metadata for one frame. Pass with: try_model.py --meta this-file.json. All six real fields must be present or coordinates stay null. Values below are a plausible shallow-water starboard channel, NOT measured -- replace them with real ones before quoting any position. Note altitude_m / range_resolution_m sets the water-column half-width in pixels (3.0/0.05 = 60 px here); detections inside it get no position, by design.
